newsitem.title: CANADA: COM DEV enjoys opening day surge.
newsitem.headline: COM DEV enjoys opening day surge.

text.p: Shares in COM DEV International Ltd jumped on Tuesday in heavy trading following the company's debut on the Montreal and Toronto stock exchanges.

COM DEV stock was up C$0.75 at C$9.00 at midday in Toronto on turnover of 1.1 million shares. Stock in the wireless communications company listed this morning after an initial public offering price of C$8.25 per common share.
Company officials, who attended a small ceremony at the Toronto Stock Exchange, were delighted with the stock's opening day performance.

"We took the advice of our underwriters who told us not to try to extract as much money as possible on the first go," said Val O'Donovan, COM DEV's chairman. "We want to have happy shareholders not just today but a year from now."
The company's willingness to spend heavily on research and development - a key to success in commercial space-based communications - is the lynchpin of COM DEV's future, O'Donovan said.
COM DEV designs and manufactures space and ground-based wireless communications products. Major clients include Nokia, Nortel and Motorola.
O'Donovan said he expects the company's space-based and ground-based sales to grow to C$150 million this year with projected earnings of C$15 million.
For the fiscal year ended October 31, 1996, the company estimates earnings of C$11 million, or C$0.40 a share, on sales of C$100 million.
